name: Enthalpy v0.4.33
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.33

## Changes

- Enthalpy is local-only. It does not require an account or a network
  connection. Hosted Sync and sign-in are removed.
- The first screen is the Workspace manager. Create a local workspace or open
  a local folder.
- File → Workspaces… opens the workspace manager when a workspace is already
  open.
- Projects and Areas share one package workspace. Notes, tasks, files, and
  YAML source stay in the same view.

## Test this preview

Start Enthalpy. The first screen must be Workspaces, not sign-in. Create or
open a local workspace. The current week dashboard must open with today
selected.

Open a Project and an Area. Both must show notes, tasks, and files in the
same package workspace. Use File → Workspaces… to return to the workspace
list.

## Known limits

This is a limited preview. Hosted Sync is not available. Work stays on this
device.
